clearedSpotChecks.check: Interpreter and integer library pins of the public replay clients and of nanoreth tags since cycle 30.
clearedSpotChecks.note: web3_clientVersion on 2026-11-27 returns reth/v0.1.0-f0cad31 on rpc.purroofgroup.com, reth/v0.1.0-b92ad36 on rpc.hyperlend.finance/archive and 'hyperliquid evm Mainnet' on rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm. The saved Cargo.lock copies pin revm 43.0.3, revm-interpreter 43.0.2 and ruint 1.20.1 (b92ad36, byte equal to master, sha256 e8cc9611370d) and revm 29.0.1, revm-interpreter 25.0.3 and ruint 1.16.0 (f0cad31). A fresh fetch of nanoreth master/Cargo.lock has sha256 e8cc9611370d. One gap in the evidence: out/tags-probe.txt records HTTP 429 for nb-20261127-2, so that probe did not settle the tag, and docs/Cargo.lock.nb-20261127-2 holds only '404: Not Found'. My own probe returned 404 for nb-20261127-2, nb-20261127-1 and nb-20261126 and 200 for nb-20261125-2, so the claim holds. The pins describe the replicas only; the official validator is closed, which is why the arithmetic check below runs against it directly. 40 MULMOD and 40 ADDMOD vectors with moduli 2^256-1, 2^256-2, 2^255, 2^256-2^128 and random, and multiplicands with equal top limbs, matched Python on all three endpoints.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Jump destination analysis on the official node, both replicas and testnet: jumps into PUSH data, into the data of a PUSH truncated at the end of the code, past the code, to offset 0 holding a PUSH, and to valid JUMPDEST offsets with bits set at 2^16, 2^32, 2^64, 2^128 or 2^255.
clearedSpotChecks.note: I ran code 0x600456605b... by state override on https://rpc.hyperliquid.xyz/evm: a JUMP to offset 4, which is the 0x5b data byte of PUSH1, returns 'EVM error: InvalidJump'. The PoolManager code at 0x12D4Fd9C5DeDd00ab8a0bCe2CF0167bbf94b6B1F is 24,009 bytes with sha256 prefix 907b85e610ad5dab, as in networks.json, so the bytecode the battery ran against is the deployed one. I did not repeat the high-bit destination cases; edges32.json records them on five endpoints.

clearedSpotChecks.check: Upcoming forks over the next six months: announcements, documentation, staged opcodes and precompiles on mainnet and testnet, validator binary.
clearedSpotChecks.note: The HyperEVM page (https://hyperliquid.gitbook.io/hyperliquid-docs/for-developers/hyperevm.md, fetched 2026-11-27) still says 'The HyperEVM uses the Cancun hardfork without blobs'. CLZ (0x1e) by state override on the official endpoint returns 'EVM error: NotActivated'. The note on EIP-7702 is right as far as the code goes: settlement and claims key on msg.sender and Currency.transfer sends to the address the caller names, so a delegated account harms only itself or acts as a pool-creator hook. RETURNDATACOPY in CustomRevert.bubbleUpAndRevertWith copies returndatasize() bytes from offset 0 (src/libraries/CustomRevert.sol:110), which is always in bounds, as the RETURNDATACOPY cleared item says.
